Aid the [[Wailing Lord (Fissure of Woe)|Wailing Lord]] in presenting a gift of three [[Forest Griffon]]s to [[Balthazar]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Escort all three Forest Griffons safely to the [[Tower of Courage]]. 
*See [[Rastigan the Eternal]] for your reward. 

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Upon accepting the quests, go near the griffons to get them to follow your team and then head back to where Rastigan the Eternal was (the [[Tower of Courage]]). There will be groups that appeared upon accepting the quest along the way, as seen in the map to the right. Be wary that the Forest Griffons can be killed easily and if just one dies the quest fails and the team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. Also, the griffons will follow moving party members in radar range.

An alternative method which takes a little bit more time but ensures not failing the quest is to head back to Rastigan and kill all the popup groups along the way '''before''' going near the Forest Griffons. Once the enemies are killed, have a party member go near the Griffons to lead them back to Rastigan.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wailing Lord
:''"Please...perhaps you can help me. I wish to express to [[Balthazar]] my sincere respect and admiration. I offer three '''Forest Griffons''' that have served me since their acceptance into this eternal realm as hounds for the God of War. You shall find them scattered throughout the forest. If you would be so kind as to gather all three and lead them to the Tower of Courage, I would be in your debt."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I'll see to it at once.
|decline = Do it yourself!
| ask = I wish to make a gift of three '''[[Forest Griffon]]s''' to the master of this realm, Great Balthazar, God of War. Please gather three griffons from my forest and lead them to the Tower of Courage that Balthazar and all who serve him may know of the loyalty that we in the forest hold toward him.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Rastigan the Eternal
:''"Balthazar will be pleased with this gift. And I am pleased with your actions. I can see that the lesson you delivered was not lost on the Wailing Lord."''

==Notes==

{{bug|If any Forest Griffon dies after the quest is completed, your party still will be defeated (even if you have done all other quests). }}
{{bug|If you turn in the quest while not all three griffons are near [[Rastigan the Eternal]] you will get the reward, but the quest log won't be updated, stopping you from progressing (the remaining griffons who were out of range will remain in your party). }}
